notes.note: Re-recorded after merging origin/main into the chat pane layout branch. The sources that differ from the merged record (src-ui/src/index.css) carry this branch's changes: the shared pane-failure card and its responsive action-surface entry, the phone dock single safe-area inset and landscape side insets, the transcript bottom fade, answer-table wrapping and scroll cue, the centred title and project-name truncation, the No-chat-open gutter, the stored-title helper in the event store, and the transcript staying in place after a turn. This document or capture was already reviewed against those changes on the branch (notes files 20261001T014216.813Z-d155028524ba.json, 20261001T134344.938Z-d18a2e395e6b.json); main's own delta to these sources is covered by the record taken from main, and the merge of these source files was clean except src-ui/src/index.css, where main removed the unused .chat-dock__empty rules next to this branch's .chat-dock__no-chat rule and both changes were kept as intended. No claim changes from the combination.
